classes.label: Thing
classes.description: Anything the Velexis system, its code or its operations name. Root of the hierarchy.

classes.label: Product
classes.description: One of the two products of Velexis: the platform (control plane: accounts, OTAs, billing) or the OTA (data plane: storefront, bookings, console).

classes.label: Agent
classes.description: Someone or something that acts: a person, a role it holds, an organisation or an operating-system account.

classes.label: Person (persona)
classes.description: A kind of human user of Velexis (a persona), e.g. the OTA owner or a traveller.

classes.label: Organisation
classes.description: A company that operates or owns part of the system.

classes.label: Role
classes.description: A named set of permissions a person, program or process holds in an authorisation decision.

classes.label: Tenant role
classes.description: A membership's role in one OTA: `owner`, `admin`, `agent`, `finance`, `viewer`. The same five roles drive the portal matrix (`memberships/tenant-roles.ts`) and the console permissions (`common/auth/roles.ts`). Also called staff role.

classes.label: Platform role
classes.description: A role of Velexis staff on the platform admin (`accounts.is_platform_admin`).

classes.label: Traveller role
classes.description: Who a storefront visitor is to the OTA API: anonymous visitor, guest with a booking token, signed-in customer.

classes.label: Caller type
classes.description: A kind of program calling the OTA API, recognised by `tenancy/` before any tenant lookup (ota/docs/architecture.md §3.1).

classes.label: Database role
classes.description: A PostgreSQL login role with a bounded privilege set (ADR-0004).

classes.label: System user
classes.description: A Linux account on the VM that runs a group of processes (trust zone, ADR-0026) or receives SSH logins.

classes.label: Software
classes.description: Code of the monorepo or a program built from it.

classes.label: Application
classes.description: A part of the monorepo with its own folder, package and guidebook app page (portal, platform-api, ota-api, storefront, ...).

classes.label: Frontend app
classes.description: A browser-facing application: the Next.js backend-for-frontend apps (portal, platform admin, OTA admin) and the static storefront.

classes.label: Backend service
classes.description: A NestJS backend that owns a database schema and runs an API process, a worker process and a CLI (platform API, OTA API).

classes.label: Library
classes.description: Code other applications import rather than run on its own: the JS SDK and the shared workspace packages.

classes.label: Shared package
classes.description: A workspace package under `packages/*` (CommonJS + .d.ts) imported by the apps; `@velexis/testing` is dev-only.

classes.label: Tool
classes.description: A developer or CI tool under `tools/*` (or a third-party CLI used in development).

classes.label: Command
classes.description: A runnable command (pnpm script or node CLI) with documented exit codes.

classes.label: Operations script
classes.description: A bash script of `deploy/scripts`, installed root-owned as `/usr/local/sbin/velexis-*` on the VM or run by hand.

classes.label: Runtime process
classes.description: An OS process an application runs as (API, Next.js server, CLI), usually under a systemd unit.

classes.label: Worker process
classes.description: A process that consumes BullMQ queues and runs schedulers; serves HTTP for health only.

classes.label: Module
classes.description: A source unit inside an application or library: a NestJS module, a React component, a generated file, a migration set, a helper.

classes.label: Build artifact
classes.description: A file or folder produced by a build: a release, a bundle, a checksum list.

classes.label: Test suite
classes.description: A set of automated tests (unit, contract, integration, Playwright project, smoke).

classes.label: Workflow
classes.description: A GitHub Actions workflow of `.github/workflows` (or a reviewed draft).

classes.label: Infrastructure
classes.description: What hosts, routes and protects the apps on the single VM rather than implementing them.

classes.label: Virtual machine
classes.description: The single Ubuntu 24.04 VM that runs every process (ADR-0007).

classes.label: Edge proxy
classes.description: The public entry point that terminates TLS and routes hosts to loopback ports (Caddy, Velexis build with Coraza).

classes.label: Firewall
classes.description: A filter in front of or on the VM: the WAF (Coraza + OWASP CRS), ufw inbound, nftables `inet velexis_egress` outbound.

classes.label: systemd unit
classes.description: A unit file installed from `deploy/systemd` (service, timer or a transient unit started by a script).

classes.label: App unit
classes.description: A long-running service of one process (Restart=always, sandboxed, OnFailure alert).

classes.label: Timer unit
classes.description: A systemd timer that starts a root-owned oneshot service on a schedule.

classes.label: Public host
classes.description: A host name Caddy serves (placeholders `*.example.com` in docs; `localhost` ports in development).

classes.label: Data store
classes.description: Where state lives: a database, schema, table, Redis key family, queue, bucket, file store or browser storage.

classes.label: Database
classes.description: A PostgreSQL database: `velexis` on the VM, or a scratch database of tests.

classes.label: Schema
classes.description: A PostgreSQL schema: `platform`, `reference` or one `tenant_<key>` per OTA (ADR-0004).

classes.label: Table
classes.description: A PostgreSQL table. Status columns are text + CHECK lists, ids are prefixed strings.

classes.label: Platform table
classes.description: A table of the shared `platform` schema, written by the platform API; the OTA backend may only read the ones granted to `velexis_ota_app`.

classes.label: Tenant table
classes.description: A table that exists once in every `tenant_<key>` schema; reached only through `tenantTx`.

classes.label: Reference table
classes.description: A table of the `reference` schema (airports, airlines, currencies...), filled by the reference loader.

classes.label: Cache server
classes.description: The Redis 7.4 server (`noeviction`, every key has a TTL): caches, sessions, one-time tokens, rate limits and BullMQ queues.

classes.label: Redis key family
classes.description: A pattern of Redis keys with one purpose and TTL (platform §6.4, ota §7).

classes.label: Queue
classes.description: A BullMQ queue (key prefix `vx`), named `<owner>-<topic>` after the backend whose worker consumes it (ADR-0009).

classes.label: Pub/sub channel
classes.description: A Redis publish/subscribe channel.

classes.label: Bucket
classes.description: Off-site object storage for encrypted backups and security logs.

classes.label: File storage
classes.description: The local file store (storage adapter, `local` driver) for booking PDFs and storefront assets.

classes.label: Cookie
classes.description: An HTTP cookie a server sets in the browser; session cookies are `__Host-`, HttpOnly, Secure and never readable by JavaScript.

classes.label: Browser storage entry
classes.description: A `sessionStorage` or `localStorage` key a storefront page uses (never tokens).

classes.label: Domain object
classes.description: A business object of Velexis, stored as rows of one or more tables.

classes.label: Tenant (OTA)
classes.description: One OTA: its `platform.tenants` row and its `tenant_<key>` schema.

classes.label: Account
classes.description: A portal identity in `platform.accounts` (OTA owners, members, platform admins).

classes.label: Customer
classes.description: A traveller account of one OTA in `tenant_<key>.customers`; never shared between OTAs.

classes.label: Membership
classes.description: An account's role in one tenant (`platform.tenant_memberships`, `stf_` ids).

classes.label: Invitation
classes.description: A pending offer of membership (`platform.tenant_invitations`, 7 days).

classes.label: Plan
classes.description: A Velexis subscription plan with limits (seats, keys, custom domains, live mode) and features.

classes.label: Subscription
classes.description: A tenant's subscription to a plan, billed by Stripe Billing or managed by hand (manual).

classes.label: Storefront domain
classes.description: A storefront host of a tenant: its `<key>` sub-domain or a verified custom domain (`platform.tenant_domains`).

classes.label: Connection
classes.description: A tenant's supplier or payment connection per environment (test/live).

classes.label: Supplier connection
classes.description: A tenant's Amadeus connection per environment: Velexis credentials with pool offices, or the OTA's own credentials.

classes.label: Payment connection
classes.description: A tenant's Stripe connection per environment in one account mode (Velexis, Connect Standard, API key).

classes.label: Amadeus account
classes.description: A Velexis Amadeus Enterprise account (shared credentials) whose offices form the pool.

classes.label: Amadeus office
classes.description: An office id of the pool assigned to at most one tenant at a time (PADR-0012).

classes.label: Credential submission
classes.description: Credentials an OTA submitted for its own Amadeus or Stripe connection, verified by the platform worker and erased after.

classes.label: Payout account
classes.description: The bank account settlements are paid to (encrypted identifiers, review status).

classes.label: Settlement
classes.description: A monthly statement of payments Velexis collected for an OTA, with lines and a payout.

classes.label: Provisioning job
classes.description: A durable job row of the tenant lifecycle (provision, migrate, suspend, resume, ...) dispatched to the OTA worker.

classes.label: Flight search
classes.description: A stored Amadeus search and its result set (`flight_searches`).

classes.label: Offer
classes.description: A priced travel option shown to a traveller.

classes.label: Flight offer
classes.description: One option of a search or upsell (fare family), with net and selling prices.

classes.label: Priced offer
classes.description: Offers re-priced by Amadeus (Flight Offers Price), the input of a checkout.

classes.label: Checkout
classes.description: Travellers, contacts, extras and payment of one priced offer, until it becomes a booking or expires.

classes.label: Booking
classes.description: An Amadeus flight order recorded for an OTA, with travellers, tickets, payments and documents.

classes.label: Ticket
classes.description: An e-ticket of a booking (`booking_tickets`).

classes.label: Payment
classes.description: A customer payment: a Stripe PaymentIntent or an airline-card charge.

classes.label: Refund
classes.description: Money returned on a payment.

classes.label: Payment method
classes.description: A way a traveller pays on the storefront.

classes.label: Booking document
classes.description: A rendered PDF of a booking: itinerary or e-ticket receipt.

classes.label: Notification
classes.description: An e-mail queued in an outbox (`platform.email_outbox`, `tenant_<key>.notifications`) and sent by a worker.

classes.label: Content
classes.description: Editable OTA content: storefront settings, pages, assets, templates.

classes.label: E-mail template
classes.description: A Handlebars template key (`<area>.<event>`) rendered into a notification; OTA templates can be overridden per locale in the console.

classes.label: Pricing rule
classes.description: A markup or fee rule of an OTA that turns net prices into selling prices.

classes.label: Log record
classes.description: An append-only record kept for audit or diagnosis: platform audit log, staff actions, supplier requests, booking events, queue snapshots.

classes.label: Interface
classes.description: A point where software meets a user or another program: endpoints, screens, SDK methods, headers, events, contracts.

classes.label: Endpoint
classes.description: An HTTP endpoint (method + path).

classes.label: API operation
classes.description: One operation of an OpenAPI document, named by its `operationId` (platform: 144, OTA: 189).

classes.label: Webhook receiver
classes.description: An endpoint that receives signed events from an external service (Stripe).

classes.label: Endpoint group
classes.description: An OpenAPI tag: the operations of one area of an API.

classes.label: UI route
classes.description: A URL path a frontend answers.

classes.label: Screen
classes.description: A rendered page of a frontend (Next.js page or static HTML page).

classes.label: Route handler
classes.description: A route that answers without a page (redirect, file download, SSO launch).

classes.label: Screen group
classes.description: Related screens and route handlers of one frontend area, as listed in the app's usage guide.

classes.label: Server action
classes.description: A Next.js `'use server'` function a form posts to; it performs one call through the API.

classes.label: SDK namespace
classes.description: A group of SDK client methods (`flights`, `checkout`, `console`, ...).

classes.label: SDK method
classes.description: One SDK client method, named by an operation's `x-sdk-method`.

classes.label: HTTP header
classes.description: A request or response header with a contract meaning.

classes.label: Event
classes.description: A message announcing that something changed: cache invalidations on `vx:invalidate`, signed Stripe events.

classes.label: Contract
classes.description: A document that defines an interface: OpenAPI documents, the frozen SDK declarations, job message schemas.

classes.label: Error type
classes.description: An error class or error code callers can handle.

classes.label: Security control
classes.description: A rule or mechanism that protects data or access.

classes.label: Permission
classes.description: A console permission (`StaffPermission`) granted by tenant role or key scope and required by `x-permission`.

classes.label: Authentication control
classes.description: Proves who the caller is: MFA, step-up, 3-D Secure, SSH second factor.

classes.label: Request control
classes.description: A check every matching request must pass: reason, If-Match, CSRF, idempotency, safe redirects.

classes.label: Rate limit
classes.description: A bound on attempts per IP, identity, tenant or key (throttler, lockouts, Amadeus buckets).

classes.label: Data protection control
classes.description: Keeps sensitive data unreadable or out of logs: envelope encryption, redaction, masking.

classes.label: Monitoring control
classes.description: Detects tampering or failure: AIDE, auditd, log review, health checks.

classes.label: Credential
classes.description: Something that authenticates a caller. The guidebook names credentials, never their values.

classes.label: API key
classes.description: A key sent as `X-Api-Key`, stored only as an HMAC hash and a prefix in `platform.api_keys` (PADR-0005).

classes.label: Publishable key
classes.description: `pk_` key for browsers: customer scope, origin allow-list.

classes.label: Secret key
classes.description: `sk_` key for servers: storefront scope or `console:automation` with permission scopes.

classes.label: Service key
classes.description: The OTA admin's first-party console credential (`OTA_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY`), accepted on direct loopback calls only.

classes.label: Token
classes.description: A bearer or opaque token: access, refresh, guest booking token.

classes.label: One-time token
classes.description: A single-use, short-lived token: portal token, e-mail link token, MFA challenge.

classes.label: Secret
classes.description: A server-side secret (pepper, edge secret, signing key, webhook secret); lives in env or key files only.

classes.label: Key encryption key
classes.description: A master key file (`local:v<N>`) that wraps the data keys of encrypted columns (ADR-0010).

classes.label: External service
classes.description: A system outside the Velexis code base.

classes.label: Supplier
classes.description: A travel content supplier.

classes.label: Payment provider
classes.description: A payment processor.

classes.label: E-mail service
classes.description: An SMTP relay (production) or catcher (Mailpit in development).

classes.label: Environment
classes.description: A context that changes behaviour or data: runtime (`APP_ENV`), storefront (test/live), deployment.

classes.label: Runtime environment
classes.description: The `APP_ENV` a process runs with.

classes.label: Storefront environment
classes.description: Test or live data and connections of an OTA (`X-Velexis-Environment`, key prefixes `pk_test_`/`pk_live_`).

classes.label: Deployment environment
classes.description: A protected GitHub environment with secrets and required reviewers.

classes.label: Flow
classes.description: A sequence of steps across apps, processes and data.

classes.label: Business flow
classes.description: A user-visible flow: sign-up, provisioning, booking, refund, go-live...

classes.label: Operations procedure
classes.description: An operator procedure: deploy, backup and restore, key rotation, local stack set-up.

classes.label: Background job
classes.description: A named kind of BullMQ job (payload carries ids only), e.g. `tenant.provision`, `ticketing.issue`.

classes.label: Schedule
classes.description: A recurring scheduler (`upsertJobScheduler`) that adds jobs or fans out per tenant.

classes.label: Lifecycle
classes.description: A state machine, usually a status column with a CHECK list, or a client-side state machine of a page.

classes.label: Lifecycle state
classes.description: One state of a lifecycle (the exact value stored in the status column).

classes.label: Configuration
classes.description: A setting that changes behaviour: feature switches, env files, SDK session modes, stub scenarios, OTA settings.

classes.label: Feature switch
classes.description: A milestone flag of the platform API (`FEATURE_*`); while off, its operations answer `403 FEATURE_DISABLED`.

classes.label: Config file
classes.description: A settings and secrets file on the VM (`/etc/velexis/<name>.env`, root:root 0600) read by systemd.

classes.label: SDK session mode
classes.description: How an SDK client authenticates and keeps sessions; chosen once per client.

classes.label: Design pattern
classes.description: A recurring engineering technique or convention of the code base (outbox, fan-out, expand-and-contract, ...).

properties.label: part of product
properties.description: The product an application belongs to (shared packages and deploy belong to none).

properties.label: operated by
properties.description: The organisation that runs the product.

properties.label: used by
properties.description: A persona that uses the application.

properties.label: holds role
properties.description: A role the persona typically holds.

properties.label: depends on
properties.description: Needs the other software to build, start or work.

properties.label: imports
properties.description: Imports the library at run time or in tests (workspace dependency).

properties.label: calls API of
properties.description: Sends HTTP requests to the backend's API (server side for the BFF apps).

properties.label: integrates with
properties.description: Calls or is called by the external service.

properties.label: runs as process
properties.description: The application is deployed as this process.

properties.label: executes
properties.description: The process or script the unit starts.

properties.label: runs on
properties.description: The VM the unit is installed on.

properties.label: runs as user
properties.description: The Linux user a unit's process runs as, or a deploy key logs in as.

properties.label: loads config
properties.description: An env file read before the process starts (`EnvironmentFile=`).

properties.label: connects as
properties.description: The PostgreSQL role in the process's or command's DSN.

properties.label: member of role
properties.description: GRANT role membership.

properties.label: owns schema
properties.description: The role that owns the schema's objects.

properties.label: reachable at
properties.description: A public host the application is served on.

properties.label: proxies to
properties.description: Caddy routes a host to this loopback process.

properties.label: protects
properties.description: The firewall filters traffic of that component.

properties.label: checks health of
properties.description: Probes the process (e.g. `/health/ready`) and alerts on failure.

properties.label: activates
properties.description: Switches the `current` link to the release.

properties.label: builds
properties.description: Produces the artifact.

properties.label: deploys to
properties.description: The protected environment that gates the workflow's deploy job.

properties.label: tested by
properties.description: A test suite that exercises it.

properties.label: run by
properties.description: A workflow that runs or publishes it.

properties.label: conforms to
properties.description: Is checked against the contract by tests.

properties.label: generated from
properties.description: Source generated from the contract (`pnpm contracts:generate`).

properties.label: provides
properties.description: Ships a command, scenario, test project or scratch resource.

properties.label: stands in for
properties.description: Replaces the external service in development and tests.

properties.label: enforces rule on
properties.description: A CI check that enforces a repository rule on the software.

properties.label: migrates
properties.description: A migration set applied to the schema.

properties.label: defines
properties.description: Holds the name and message contract of a queue, channel or other shared definition.

properties.label: owns
properties.description: The application is the source of truth: it migrates and writes the data store.

properties.label: reads
properties.description: Reads the data store (without owning it).

properties.label: writes
properties.description: Inserts, updates or deletes data (tables, Redis keys, cookies, browser storage, buckets).

properties.label: touches table
properties.description: A table in the operation's `x-tenant-tables` / `x-platform-tables` (read or written).

properties.label: contained in
properties.description: Table in schema, schema in database, key family or queue in the Redis server.

properties.label: references
properties.description: A foreign key from one table to another (from the migrations).

properties.label: stored in
properties.description: Where an object, credential or lifecycle status is kept.

properties.label: enqueues to
properties.description: Adds jobs to the queue (after commit).

properties.label: consumes
properties.description: Processes the queue's jobs.

properties.label: consumed by
properties.description: The worker that processes the queue.

properties.label: publishes on
properties.description: Publishes messages on the channel.

properties.label: subscribes to
properties.description: Listens to the channel.

properties.label: carries job
properties.description: A kind of job added to the queue.

properties.label: on queue
properties.description: The queue jobs of this kind are added to.

properties.label: runs schedule
properties.description: The worker registers and runs the scheduler.

properties.label: scheduled on
properties.description: The queue the scheduler's jobs are added to.

properties.label: triggers job
properties.description: Causes jobs of this kind (an operation, schedule or flow).

properties.label: encrypts data in
properties.description: The key wraps the data keys of ciphertext columns of the table.

properties.label: has membership
properties.description: An account's memberships.

properties.label: membership in
properties.description: The tenant a membership belongs to.

properties.label: has role
properties.description: The role of a membership.

properties.label: on plan
properties.description: The tenant's current plan (`plan_code`).

properties.label: has subscription
properties.description: The tenant's current subscription.

properties.label: has schema
properties.description: The tenant's schema `tenant_<key>`.

properties.label: has domain
properties.description: Storefront hosts of the tenant.

properties.label: has connection
properties.description: Supplier and payment connections per environment.

properties.label: assigned office
properties.description: Pool offices of a Velexis-credential connection.

properties.label: office of
properties.description: The Velexis Amadeus account the office belongs to.

properties.label: uses Amadeus account
properties.description: The shared credentials a Velexis-mode connection uses.

properties.label: issues key
properties.description: API keys of the tenant.

properties.label: in environment
properties.description: The environment (test/live, runtime, deployment) a thing belongs to.

properties.label: result of
properties.description: The search an offer came from.

properties.label: confirms offer
properties.description: The offers a priced offer re-prices.

properties.label: opened with
properties.description: The priced offer a checkout was opened with.

properties.label: created from
properties.description: The checkout that became the booking (none for PNR imports).

properties.label: pays for
properties.description: The booking a payment pays for.

properties.label: paid by
properties.description: Payments of a booking.

properties.label: refund of
properties.description: The payment a refund belongs to.

properties.label: document of
properties.description: The booking a PDF belongs to.

properties.label: ticket of
properties.description: The booking a ticket belongs to.

properties.label: booked by
properties.description: The signed-in customer (NULL for guests).

properties.label: priced with
properties.description: Markup and fee rules applied to the selling price.

properties.label: paid with
properties.description: How the payment is made.

properties.label: processed by
properties.description: Stripe for card payments; none for airline cards.

properties.label: fulfilled by
properties.description: The supplier holding the order.

properties.label: settled in
properties.description: The settlement that includes a Velexis-collected payment.

properties.label: rendered from
properties.description: The template of an outbox e-mail.

properties.label: customer of
properties.description: The OTA a customer account belongs to.

properties.label: invited to
properties.description: The tenant of an invitation.

properties.label: provisions
properties.description: The tenant a provisioning job works on.

properties.label: has lifecycle
properties.description: The state machine of an object.

properties.label: has state
properties.description: A state of the lifecycle.

properties.label: initial state
properties.description: The state a new row starts in (the column default).

properties.label: transitions to
properties.description: An allowed transition.

properties.label: drives lifecycle
properties.description: An operation, job, schedule or app that moves the lifecycle.

properties.label: exposes
properties.description: Serves the operations of the group.

properties.label: in group
properties.description: The OpenAPI tag of an operation.

properties.label: served by
properties.description: The application that implements the endpoint or group.

properties.label: has screens
properties.description: A screen group of the frontend.

properties.label: calls operation
properties.description: Rendering or submitting this calls the operation (SDK methods wrap one operation each).

properties.label: calls operations of
properties.description: Calls (some) operations of the group.

properties.label: requires permission
properties.description: Needs this permission (`x-permission`, `requireStaff`).

properties.label: grants permission
properties.description: The role (or key scope) holds the permission.

properties.label: allowed for
properties.description: Callers in this role may use it; others get a refusal or the not-allowed page.

properties.label: may use
properties.description: The role may use (some) operations or screens of it.

properties.label: may open environment
properties.description: Environments the role may use in the console (live also needs a live OTA).

properties.label: requires control
properties.description: A control the request must pass (reason, step-up, If-Match, MFA...).

properties.label: gated by
properties.description: Answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED (or is hidden) while the switch is off.

properties.label: sends e-mail
properties.description: Queues e-mails of this template in an outbox.

properties.label: offers payment method
properties.description: The screen lets the traveller pay this way.

properties.label: hands off to
properties.description: Ends by sending the browser to another application or external service.

properties.label: offers namespace
properties.description: A namespace on every SDK client.

properties.label: throws
properties.description: An error class callers should handle (`@throws`).

properties.label: uses session mode
properties.description: Creates its SDK clients in this mode.

properties.label: authenticates with
properties.description: A credential (or the cookie carrying it) the caller sends.

properties.label: carried in
properties.description: The cookie or header that carries the credential.

properties.label: accepts caller
properties.description: The API accepts this kind of caller.

properties.label: defined in
properties.description: The contract document that defines it.

properties.label: receives from
properties.description: The service that sends the signed events.

properties.label: delivered on
properties.description: The channel or endpoint that carries the event.

properties.label: issued by
properties.description: The application that issues and verifies the credential.

properties.label: involves
properties.description: A screen, operation, job, table or service the flow goes through.

properties.label: followed by
properties.description: The flow that usually comes next.

properties.label: enforced by
properties.description: The software or infrastructure that enforces the control.
